subject: Demo coordination: SGD/JST/AEST rollover check
messages:
From: Kaito Tanaka <k.tanaka@sunrise-tech.jp>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mei Lin <mei.lin@oceanic.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 23:12:00 +0900 (JST)
Subject: Intro + PoC demo — availability (SGD/JST/AEST)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick reply on our inbound form. We’re excited to take a look at Redwood and validate latency/cost for a small PoC. Team availability next week (local times):

- Mon Aug 16: 10:00–13:00 JST (09:00–12:00 SGT, 12:00–15:00 AEST)
- Tue Aug 17: 09:00–11:00 JST (08:00–10:00 SGT)

Would you be able to run a 45–60 minute demo focusing on streaming, model routing, and cost controls? I attached a quick CSV with who will join.

Kaito
Head of Engineering, Sunrise Tech
Attachments: prospect-availability.csv (CSV)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kaito Tanaka <k.tanaka@sunrise-tech.jp>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro + PoC demo — availability (SGD/JST/AEST)

Hi Kaito — great to hear, thanks for the options.

I created a calendar invite for Mon Aug 16 at 09:30 SGT / 10:30 JST (45 minutes) — that should land in the window you suggested. Priyom from Solutions will join to cover the PoC checklist.

Quick note: our calendar defaults sometimes end up showing local conversions differently depending on the recipient calendar client. If you see a strange date/time in the invite (e.g., midnight), please ignore it — I’ll follow up with UTC timestamps and an ics.

Agenda (high level):
- 10m intros
- 20m demo (streaming + routing)
- 10m PoC scope & next steps
- 5m Q&A

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)
From: Kaito Tanaka <k.tanaka@sunrise-tech.jp>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mei Lin <mei.lin@oceanic.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro + PoC demo — availability (SGD/JST/AEST)

Vanessa — thanks. Quick heads up: the invite that arrived in our calendars shows as Tue Aug 17 00:30 SGT (midnight) for several attendees. I assume that’s a timezone conversion bug — it would be outside business hours for our APAC participants.

Can we confirm using UTC times to avoid the rollover confusion? For reference, 09:30 SGT = 01:30 UTC, 10:30 JST = 01:30 UTC, 12:30 AEST = 02:30 UTC.

If the intent was a morning APAC slot, can you please send either: 1) a corrected invite with explicit UTC time and local translations, or 2) two alternate slots in the morning window so we can pick?

Appreciate it — Mei and I will wait for the corrected ics.

Best,
Kaito
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kaito Tanaka <k.tanaka@sunrise-tech.jp>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 17:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro + PoC demo — availability (SGD/JST/AEST)

Kaito — very sorry about the midnight conversion, and thanks for the exact UTC conversions — that made it obvious. The issue was my calendar client defaulting the invite to my local timezone and then creating an all-day offset for some recipients.

I’ve attached a corrected ics (corrected-demo-invite.ics) and included three explicit options below with UTC and local times — please reply with the preferred option and I’ll lock it in:

Option A (preferred):
- 2027-08-16 01:30 UTC — 09:30 SGT / 10:30 JST / 11:30 AEST (45 min)
Option B:
- 2027-08-16 00:00 UTC — 08:00 SGT / 09:00 JST / 10:00 AEST (45 min, earlier window)
Option C:
- 2027-08-16 02:30 UTC — 10:30 SGT / 11:30 JST / 12:30 AEST (45 min, later morning)

Note: none of these times are affected by daylight savings this month (APAC locations listed do not observe DST in August), but I included UTC to be safe across clients.

If you prefer Priyom and I can drop the invite and you manually add attendees, we can do that too — whatever avoids the calendar-tool churn.

Thanks again and apologies for the confusion — will wait on your pick.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: corrected-demo-invite.ics (ICS)
